For each region table (Boston, Chatham, Amherst, Ashburnham): coerce Year to numeric and filter to Year==2020; parse Jun/Jul/Aug precipitation to numeric (treat 'M' as missing, 'T' as 0); compute JJA total rainfall (Jun+Jul+Aug) requiring all three months present (skipna=False); concatenate into one table and rank regions by descending JJA total.
